captures.q: tell me about the contemporary book Pearl and Other Poems
captures.description: Reads the 2014 New Human Press book as poetry and literary fiction about authorship at once. Names the Browning-Pound-Pessoa lineage the project declares, treats Sigil's attributed introduction as producing a recursive effect, and poses the reading questions the apparatus generates: who is speaking, is Lee Sharks author or character, how much authority the introduction carries, where parody ends. 156pp paperback. Later turns go to the poems.
